description:
The property is being sensitively refurbished to accommodate single-family use while preserving its architectural heritage. Works span from Lower Ground (LG) to Third Floor (3F). 

1. Extensions & Façade Treatment - LG extension into rear garden; façade to be clad with matching finish for unified rear elevation with 1F. - 1F extended full width to improve daylight to central core. 

2. Staircase & Floorboard Restoration - Staircases from LG to 2F to be repaired, refinished. - 2F to 3F staircase structurally unsound; will be rebuilt with like-for-like finish (structural survey attached). - All floorboards from GF corridor to 2F surveyed and restored: retain good boards, sand & refinish painted ones, and replace damaged 
boards with matched species (150–250mm width). 

3. Internal Features & Layout Adjustments - GF corridor feature repaired and retained. - New 1500mm doorway added for functional access while maintaining memory of cellular plan. - GF sliding door replaces existing, preserving spatial character. - GF rearranged: kitchen removed, bathroom added, new kitchen installed in rear room. - 1F and 2F bathrooms added or reconfigured for family use. 

4. Windows & Glazing Improvements - GF: secondary glazing in living room.- 1F front: repair existing windows + secondary glazing; rear: replace with double-glazed timber windows. - 2F front: replace with like-for-like single-glazed timber casement windows + secondary glazing; rear: new double-glazed timber windows. - 3F: all replaced front and rear with double-glazed timber windows. 

5. Lower Ground Enhancements - Existing single-glazed timber doors replaced with double-glazed timber for thermal performance. - Damp proofing introduced. - LG vault: new metal doors and paving light replace open grating for functional reuse and daylight access. 

6. External Façade & Heritage Conservation - Entire façade repaired and repainted; broken glass replaced, letterings restored. 

The works reflect a careful balance between upgrading living standards and retaining heritage features and respecting the memory of existing spatial arrangements.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin either before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission or before the expiration of two years from the date of the last of the reserved matters to be approved, whichever is the later.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 92 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans- P120-000, P120-001, P120-002, P120-003, P120-004,  P120-005,  P120-006, Heritage Impact Assessment Issue 03 July 2025, Design and Access Statement 8th July 2025 Rev.2. 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
